appName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Web Store. Brand name — keep as-is unless the language needs a transliteration.

appDesc.message: Anti-procrastination overlay that intercepts blocked domains with a motivational gate.
appDesc.description: Extension description in the Web Store.

popupEnableAria.description: aria-label for the on/off toggle in the toolbar popup.

popupTollList.description: Popup row label: number of listed sites.

popupChecking.description: Placeholder status shown before the active tab is resolved.

popupOpenSettings.description: Popup button that opens the options page.

popupNoTab.description: Popup status when there is no active tab.

popupInternalPage.description: Popup status for chrome:// and other non-http pages.

popupNotOnList.description: Popup status when the current site is not gated.

popupWindowOpen.message: on your toll list · window open $TIME$
popupWindowOpen.description: Popup status while the unlock window is counting down. $TIME$ is a M:SS clock.

popupTollArmed.message: on your toll list · toll armed
popupTollArmed.description: Popup status when the site is gated and the toll will fire.

popupStat.description: Daily tally in the popup. Keep the <b> tags and the × sign.

optionsTitle.description: Browser tab title of the settings page.

optionsSubtitle.message: Your settings save automatically. The toll runs every time you reach a listed site.
optionsSubtitle.description: Settings page subtitle. Keep the <b> tags.

optionsTollListHint.message: Sites that charge a toll before they open. Add a path to gate one section — e.g. youtube.com/shorts tolls Shorts but not the rest of YouTube.
optionsTollListHint.description: Hint under the Toll list heading. Keep the <code> tags and the domain example literal.

optionsNorthStarHint.message: The picture you'll see on the toll screen — what you said you wanted. One shows at a time, picked at random.

optionsPhrasesHint.message: Written in your own words. One appears under the photo each time the toll runs.

optionsTollHint.message: How much friction stands between you and the scroll.

optionsCountdownD.message: The wait before the “open anyway” button unlocks.

optionsSec.description: Short unit label for seconds, shown next to the countdown number.

optionsMin.description: Short unit label for minutes, shown next to the unlock-window and reminder-interval numbers.

optionsUnlockD.message: How long the site stays open once you pay the toll.

optionsTollEndnote.message: When the window ends, the toll returns — every time.

optionsFrictionHint.message: While a toll site is open, a small pop-up shows one of your phrases and how long you've been on the tab. Time only counts while the tab is in front of you.

optionsRemindersD.message: Show the pop-up while you're on a toll site.

optionsEveryK.description: Label before the reminder interval value, reads as 'Every 5 min'.

optionsEveryD.message: Minutes on the tab between pop-ups.

optionsThemeHint.message: Recolors the toll screen, the popup, and this page.

optionsSupportHint.message: If the toll keeps you off the scroll, you can buy me a coffee. Entirely optional — thank you.

optionsSaved.description: Toast shown after a setting is saved.

optionsRemove.description: Button that removes a domain or phrase from a list.

optionsEmptyDomains.message: nothing on your toll list yet — add a site above

optionsEmptyPhrases.message: no phrases yet — write something that hits

optionsPhotoLabel.description: Fallback caption for an uploaded photo without a filename.

optionsCompressWarn.message: compressed photo is $KB$KB (over $MAX$KB) — saved anyway, but consider a smaller one

frictionEyebrow.description: Small brand label at the top of a friction reminder card.

frictionTimeOnTab.description: Friction card line showing time on the tab. Keep the <b> tags; reorder freely for your language.

popupAccessRevoked.message: site access is off — the toll cannot run
popupAccessRevoked.description: Popup status when the user has revoked host access, so no gate can appear.

popupGrantAccess.description: Popup button that re-requests host access after the user revoked it.

defaultPhrase1.message: your future self will thank you

defaultPhrase2.message: you have bigger goals than this

defaultPhrase4.message: every minute here is a minute away from what matters
